description: This file defines the FormulasPane class responsible for rendering mathematical formulas and sensor data in a GUI component. It dynamically updates formulas based on vehicle configuration and sensor inputs, using LaTeX rendering.

classes.name: FormulasPane
classes.description: A GUI component for displaying and updating dynamic vehicle-related formulas based on sensor data and configurations, rendered with LaTeX.

methods.name: updateFormula
methods.description: Fetches current controller and configuration, determines the formula to display based on configuration algorithm, and updates the LaTeX-rendered formula in the UI.

methods.name: getAccelerationVariables
methods.description: Generates LaTeX strings representing acceleration-related sensor variables and thresholds.

methods.name: getSpeedDensity
methods.description: Constructs LaTeX strings for speed-density mode calculations, including air mass and fuel calculations based on sensor inputs.

methods.name: getInjecctorLag
methods.description: Returns LaTeX string for injector lag based on battery voltage sensor.

methods.name: oneDecimal
methods.description: Formats a sensor value as one decimal string.

methods.name: twoDecimals
methods.description: Formats a sensor value as two decimals string.
